description: This Java class implements a <calculate> element for a mini-language used in the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides functionality to perform various arithmetic calculations and assign the result to a specified field, supporting options like formatting, rounding, and type casting.

classes.name: Calculate
classes.description: Main class implementing the <calculate> operation, supporting various arithmetic calculations and type conversions based on XML configuration.

classes.name: Calculate.SubCalc
classes.description: Interface for sub-elements (<calcop>, <number>) that define parts of the calculation.

classes.name: Calculate.CalcOp
classes.description: Represents a calculation operation (<calcop>) such as add, subtract, multiply, divide, or negate.

classes.name: Calculate.NumberOp
classes.description: Represents a number literal (<number>) used in calculations.

classes.name: Calculate.InvalidOp
classes.description: Represents an invalid sub-element used as a placeholder when element validation fails.

classes.name: Calculate.CalculateFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of the Calculate operation.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the calculation based on the configured sub-elements, applies rounding and formatting, and stores the result in the specified field.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates an XML-like string representation of the <calculate> element with current configuration.

methods.name: calcValue
methods.description: Calculates a BigDecimal value for the sub-element, used by <calcop> and <number> elements.
